description: This Kotlin source file defines the `Scheduler` class, responsible for scheduling and canceling rules using WorkManager with fallback to AlarmManager in an Android application. It manages delayed execution of rules represented by `LockRule` objects, scheduling work either via `WorkManager` or via `AlarmManager` if setup with an alarm.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: A class that manages scheduling and canceling rules, using WorkManager predominantly, with AlarmManager as a fallback.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a rule to be executed after a delay based on `rule.triggerAtMillis`, utilizing WorkManager for API-appropriate scheduling, with fallback to AlarmManager if WorkManager fails.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled rule, removing the associated alarm or work request.
